newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products all gain, fuel oil active.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all gain, fuel oil active.

text.p: NWE oil products were all firmer on Friday morning, fuel oil racing ahead of gas oil gains in active trading, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded from $120 to $121 fob Rotterdam, the higher level for running refinery material. Traders said about 10,000 tonnes sold in early morning deals.

Heating oil barges were up $2 a tonne as IPE gas oil futures gained. Premiums were steady, prompt offered at Oct IPE +$8 fob ARA. Trading was thin as a number of German players carried Thursday's public holiday through to the weekend.
